# Empowering Small Businesses with a Reliable Local Delivery Service


Running a small business comes with numerous challenges, and ensuring that your customers receive their orders quickly and efficiently shouldn’t be one of them. That’s where Getcho steps in.


Getcho offers local delivery services for small business owners who want to provide a seamless shopping experience to their customers. Whether you’re delivering books, clothes, or specialty items, Getcho is the reliable partner you need to keep your customers happy and returning for more.


With Getcho, you can expand your reach, offer your customers convenience, and let us handle the logistics, allowing you to focus on what matters most—growing your business.


## How Small Businesses Use Getcho for Local Delivery


By partnering with Getcho, you can offer your customers the added convenience of local delivery, making your products more accessible. No more juggling multiple delivery services or worrying about late deliveries. You can manage all your local delivery needs with our user-friendly Business Dashboard, designed to streamline your operations and provide full control over your deliveries.[Learn more about how Getcho works](https://getcho.app/how-getcho-works/) .


## Why Small Businesses Chose Getcho for Local Delivery


### **1. Flexible, Reliable Delivery Options**


Whether you need deliveries within a few hours or scheduled for later, Getcho adapts to your business’s needs. Our couriers are available when you need them, ready to pick up and deliver directly to your customers, ensuring timely and efficient service.


### **2. Simplified Logistics for Your Team**


Managing delivery logistics can be a headache for small businesses. Getcho eliminates the hassle with a user-friendly business dashboard, providing real-time tracking and updates for you and your customers.


### **3. Enhanced Customer Service**


Getcho ensures that your customers get their orders quickly and securely. With flexible insurance options, your business can provide peace of mind for valuable or fragile items, reducing the risk of costly delays or damages.


## How Customers Use Getcho for Local Delivery


Whether you’re tired of waiting for online orders or want to support your favorite local businesses, Getcho is here to make your shopping experience quick and effortless.


With our local delivery service for small business, your orders will be delivered to your doorstep ASAP. No hassle, no fuss, no waiting. Our service makes sure your delivery arrives on time and at the right place.


### Place Your Order for Curbside/In-Store Pickup


1. **Search for Your Items:** Browse the website of your chosen small business and add your desired items to the cart. Keep in mind that some businesses may prefer to take orders over the phone.
2. **Proceed to Checkout:** Follow the checkout steps by entering the required details. Some stores may offer a shipping method where you can select “curbside pickup” or “in-store pickup.” They will then provide you with information on the availability of your items.
3. **Confirm Order is Ready:** Once your order is ready for pickup, you’ll get an email, text or call.


### Download Getcho


Get the app from the[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/getcho/id1460402210) or the[Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gtcho) and create an account if you don’t have one yet.


### Input Your Pickup Details


1. **Store Address:** Enter the store location address.
2. **Name on Order:** Provide the name used for the order.
3. **Phone Number:** Give your phone number so the driver can contact you if needed.
4. **Pickup Notes:** Include details to help the driver locate your order, such as, “This is an in-store order from Wanda’s Design Store for James Vidal. Call if there are any issues.”


### Input Your Drop-Off Details


Provide your phone number along with any details that will help the driver find you, like your apartment number or specific drop-off instructions. You can submit your order for immediate delivery or schedule it for a later date or time.


Getcho will provide a tracking link to follow your driver’s journey and send you text updates at each stage. You can also contact your driver anytime with questions or concerns.


## Your Local Business Delivery Solution


Getcho’s local delivery service for small business covers everything from specialty items like film, samples, prototypes, and parts for job sites to books, groceries, and clothes. Whether you’re a photographer, an electrician, or an artisan shop owner, Getcho is the trusted delivery solution for small businesses across the city.
